gp.distributions.formula: gp_distributions = Σ GP tier proceeds across the hold
gp.distributions.note: Total cash distributed to the GP through the waterfall.

gp.irr.formula: gp_irr = rate r where Σ CFₜ ÷ (1 + r)ᵗ = 0
gp.irr.note: Calculated, not sourced — solved iteratively over the GP cash flow stream (period 0 = −GP contributed equity).

gp_additional_contributions.formula: gp_additional_contributions = Σ deficit-period equity draws × gp_equity_pct
gp_additional_contributions.note: GP share of every capital call funded pro-rata by ownership split when a period's project cash is negative.

lp.distributions.formula: lp_distributions = Σ LP tier proceeds across the hold
lp.distributions.note: Total cash distributed to the LP through the waterfall.

lp.irr.formula: lp_irr = rate r where Σ CFₜ ÷ (1 + r)ᵗ = 0
lp.irr.note: Calculated, not sourced — solved iteratively over the LP cash flow stream (period 0 = −LP contributed equity).

lp_additional_contributions.formula: lp_additional_contributions = Σ deficit-period equity draws × lp_equity_pct
lp_additional_contributions.note: LP share of every capital call funded pro-rata by ownership split when a period's project cash is negative.

promote_earned.formula: promote_earned = Σ (GP tier share − GP pro-rata share)
promote_earned.note: GP carried interest above its pro-rata equity share.

tier_allocations[0].gp_amount.formula: gp_amount = GP split of the 'Return of Capital' tier's distributed cash

tier_allocations[0].lp_amount.formula: lp_amount = LP split of the 'Return of Capital' tier's distributed cash

tier_allocations[1].gp_amount.formula: gp_amount = GP split of the 'Preferred Return' tier's distributed cash

tier_allocations[1].lp_amount.formula: lp_amount = LP split of the 'Preferred Return' tier's distributed cash

tier_allocations[2].gp_amount.formula: gp_amount = GP split of the 'Tier 2 (to 15%)' tier's distributed cash

tier_allocations[2].lp_amount.formula: lp_amount = LP split of the 'Tier 2 (to 15%)' tier's distributed cash

total_contributions.note: Initial equity plus every additional contribution — the peak equity funded.

avg_coc.note: Average annual levered cash yield across the hold.

equity_multiple.note: total_distributions = Σ annual cash-flow-after-debt + net_proceeds at exit.

gross_sale_price.note: Direct-cap terminal value at the end of the hold. terminal_noi is the final projected year's NOI grown one more year at revpar_growth.

levered_irr.formula: levered_irr = rate r where Σ CFₜ ÷ (1 + r)ᵗ = 0
levered_irr.note: Calculated, not read from a document. Solved iteratively (Newton's method — no closed form) as the rate that zeroes the NPV of the equity cash flows: Year 0 = −equity invested, Years 1…N = cash flow after debt service, plus net sale proceeds at exit.

net_proceeds.note: Equity proceeds at sale, after debt payoff.

unlevered_irr.formula: unlevered_irr = rate r where Σ CFₜ ÷ (1 + r)ᵗ = 0
unlevered_irr.note: Calculated asset-level IRR before debt — same iterative solve. Year 0 = −purchase price, Years 1…N = NOI, plus net sale at exit.

year_one_coc.note: Year-1 levered cash yield on invested equity.
